summary: In Spokane, Washington, Spokane Community Resilience Hub Network Pilot is a pilot initiative. The documented approach is to develop a multi-hazard resilience-hub network pilot for heat, wildfire smoke, and service continuity. The case addresses heat and wildfire smoke. Available materials report pilot sites/model and planned engagement are reported. The available materials do not identify a measured outcome. The case is presented as an implementation example, not as evidence that the same results will occur in another place or under different conditions.
